scientific_question: Can local-equilibrium response provide an orthogonal reliability criterion that distinguishes a structurally supported synthetic genetic mechanism from a deliberately higher-confidence but structurally incorrect decoy?

claim_scope.allowed_if_go: Synthetic local-equilibrium compatibility can distinguish graph-consistent candidate mechanisms from deliberately high-confidence structural decoys under the frozen controlled generator.
prohibited: real genomic loci are biological steady states
equilibrium compatibility is a posterior probability
equilibrium compatibility reweights or filters real-data PIPs
the experiment validates a real-GWAS Z-to-equilibrium-field mapping
the experiment establishes disease mechanism or regulatory causality

model.state_space: magnetization u in (-1,1)^p; Bernoulli-like activity q=(u+1)/2 only for descriptive interpretation
model.global_contraction_design: ||W||_2 is rescaled to 0.30, therefore global Lipschitz constant <=0.30<1

world_generator.true_mechanism_rule: choose a source with at least one within-module outgoing edge; target is its largest-|weight| within-module outgoing edge; claimed direction is sign(delta*W[target,source])
world_generator.high_confidence_wrong_rule: same source; target is a non-neighbor in a different module chosen to minimize in/out-degree mismatch to the true target; claimed direction equals the true claimed direction
world_generator.wrong_sign_control: same source and true target with opposite claimed direction
world_generator.permuted_graph_control: apply a non-identity simultaneous row/column permutation P W P^T while keeping source/target labels fixed

confidence_stress_test.interpretation: synthetic adversarial confidence assignment; not a model of calibrated real-world confidence
confidence_stress_test.purpose: force confidence and equilibrium reliability to disagree by construction so the reliability axis cannot be mistaken for another confidence score

mechanism_reliability.admissibility: both baseline and perturbed solves residual<=1e-10 and effective spectral radius<=0.35

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95% CI for median paired delta

secondary_endpoints: matched true-mechanism R_eq versus wrong-sign control
matched true-mechanism R_eq versus permuted-graph true-label control
distribution of residuals and effective spectral radii

hard_preconditions: 128/128 worlds generated without adaptive regeneration after endpoint inspection
all matched baseline and perturbed equilibrium solves are admissible
no NaN/Inf and no duplicate true/wrong target identity within a world
go_requires_all: 95% bootstrap lower bound for median paired delta > 0
no_go_if_any: formal contract hash or runner hash differs from frozen manifest
formal execution occurs without explicit authorization token
